addr: 35/38, 24th Main Rd, opposite Brigade Palmsprings, Achappa Layout, Ramaiah Garden, JP Nagar 7th Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

rev.t: My third visit to Brahma Brews and as always the place has lived up to the bar set back in 2022. …

Brahma Brews has a really nice ambiance with a relaxed, chill vibe that's perfect for spending an evening with family or friends. The overall atmosphere, seating, and setup are definitely the highlights of the place and are the main reason …

Good ambiance and very friendly service. Their own brew is really good and worth trying. Most of the dishes were good too. I didn't like the cheese garlic bread, but everything else was good. If you can, sit near the fountain for a better experience. Overall, a nice place to visit.
